decisions.text: behaviour: the guest read-back also returns declineReason (an enum, never the member's text; `other` is left out) so the status page can show the reason Q3(a) asks for — reverse: drop declineReason from guestView in server/routes/public.js and the pb_decline_* lines on the status page

behaviour: the done page remembers the last token per slug in localStorage (the plan's P1 item) and shows 'הבקשה האחרונה שלך' on reopening — reverse: remove readLast/writeLast in public-request.page.ts

behaviour: the e2e specs enable the `tasting` kind on the QA profile when it is off (PUT on the data API) and set the profile to pilot with the new script — reverse: delete that branch in e2e/ui/555-1.spec.ts
behaviour: in-page back calls history.back(), and the step lives in a ?step= query, so browser back and in-page back are the same history — reverse: drive the step from a signal instead
behaviour: the pb_* strings the plan did not list (pb_next, pb_retry, pb_copy, pb_invalid_field, pb_new_request, pb_decline_*) have my wording — reverse: edit those keys in dictionary.json

behaviour: the unit specs found that a pending 6-second 'waking up' timer kept the Angular zone unstable, so the page starts that timer outside the zone — reverse: remove the runOutsideAngular wrapper (the specs then wait 6 s per test)

behaviour: the browser log also masks `context.url` (the interceptor logs API URLs that carry the token), beyond the location.pathname masking the plan names — reverse: remove maskContextUrl_ in logging.service.ts

seen: the pre-commit no-semi hook strips semicolons from CSS inside inline `styles:` template strings; a component with inline CSS gets broken CSS. I moved my styles to a .scss file; the hook lives in .husky / the staged-file scripts.
